title: Coffee
body:
I like going
to a corner Turkish café,
where Turks work.
Usually, what I order is:
a künefe (they make it exceptionally well)
and the coffee that, logically, holds a record for the most names worldwide;
the one known to all as Greek, Turkish, Armenian, Cypriot, Asia Minor coffee.
Obviously, the name is determined
by the people drinking it
and as we know,
anything ethnic that is, in its essence, shared
sparks disputes.
"What would you like?"
Wishing to be discreet and not "provocative", I reply:
"I would like a künefe and a medium Turkish coffee".
"You mean Greek?".
Surprised, I reply "Yes!".
To love the essence,
to accept what is different,
may the neighbor's goat live TOO.
That, is respect.

y.f.
